title: 1,000km Cable to the Stars - The Skyhook
summary: Kurzgesagt explains the skyhook, a rotating cable with a counterweight that could catapult spacecraft from Earth orbit toward deep space. It covers why it would make space travel cheaper and more efficient.
why: Used as the accessible reference for skyhook and space tether ideas in HN discussions of Mars transit, launch and space elevators.
